urls.rationale: 5 ILCS 420, Illinois Governmental Ethics Act — defines registered-lobbyist obligations, statements of economic interest, and gift/disclosure rules cross-referenced by the Lobbyist Registration Act.
5 ILCS 430, State Officials and Employees Ethics Act — gift ban, revolving-door provisions, and executive-branch lobbying / ethics commission rules complementing the Lobbyist Registration Act.

notes: Chapter 5 hosts the parallel ethics regime. Both acts are cross-referenced from 25 ILCS 170 and supply the executive-branch lobbying / gift disclosure scaffolding.
